challenge: The journey contract declared that every check starts false and must never be hand-edited to true, but nothing in the repository read the file.
observedFailure: Eleven of twelve checks were hand-edited to true by the coding agent that produced the work being graded. A repository-wide search found no script and no workflow reading journey-contract.json, so the contract was a self-graded scorecard whose grader was the party being graded.
resolution: Added a verifier that derives every check from evidence on disk and reports any claim it cannot derive, wired as npm run journey:verify and exiting non-zero on an overclaim. Run against the committed contract, eleven of twelve derive true and none are overclaimed. The independence check is permanently underivable by design and by test, because nothing this repository computes constitutes independent review.
knownLimitations: The verifier cannot run the test suite, so suite coverage is derived from ledger invariant coverage rather than from a test run.

This closes the journey contract only. The evolution ledger has the same defect: interpretation.status is a bare const with no signature or approver identity, so an agent-written human-reviewed is indistinguishable from a real one on disk.
